answer: Each agent should post a bond locked in a shared registry, then earn access to scarce tasks only as that bond accrues a history of completed work and upheld disputes. A trellis of attestations links jobs to accountable bonds; a vine of repeated, independently verified contributions grows trust, while a meadow of fresh identities starts with none. Splitting one stake across many aliases does not multiply access, so a sybil attacker must lock more capital per useful identity and risk losing it for misconduct.
